chemistry.mixtures-explain-items.0002.all: pencil (graphite) is insoluble in the solvent so does not move/separate; ink would dissolve and its dyes would move up and interfere with results

chemistry.mixtures-extended-items.0005.all: use a magnet to remove iron filings; add water and stir to dissolve salt; filter - sand is residue, wash and dry it; heat filtrate to evaporate some water then leave to crystallise; filter/dry salt crystals

chemistry.mixtures-practical-items.0007.all: mark solvent front before paper dries; measure with ruler from baseline to centre of spot and from baseline to solvent front
